title.narrative: With the support of PMD, high-quality annual plans were developed promptly and were backed by systematic monitoring. PMD facilitated partnership formulation with implementing partners, who managed a total of US$385 million. By year-end, the country office had fully utilized US$699.7 million. This included US$34.3 million of Regular Resources (RR), US$126.5 million of Other Resources Emergency (ORE), and US$507 million of Other Resources Regular (ORR), all at 100% utilization.
